snippet.title: Beast Awakening: Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the intense world of Beast Awakening, a one-versus-many multiplayer game that immerses you in a grim fantasy realm where survival is not a guarantee. 

Choose your role as part of a team of skilled Hunters or become the elusive and powerful Beast. Engage in a high-stakes game of hide and seek, where strategic action drafting makes every move count and will spell your victory or doom.

With this release, we are introducing a new Hunter! We are thrilled to officially introduce Sylva, a blind hunter who stalks her prey using sound alone, guided by three ethereal masks. 

Support our vision and get exclusive rewards on Kickstarter! 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ebstudio/beast-unleashed

Sign up for beta testing on our website!
Website: https://beastawakening.com
